description: This file contains extension methods for handling file system paths, including combining paths, resolving relative segments, and generating temporary file names.

classes.name: PathExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for path manipulation such as combining paths, resolving relative paths, and generating temporary file names.

methods.name: Combine
methods.description: Combines two or more path segments into a single path, handling root paths and separators.

methods.name: ResolvePath
methods.description: Resolves relative segments like '.' and '..' in a given path to produce an absolute-like path.

methods.name: GetTempFileName
methods.description: Generates a unique temporary file path in the system's temp directory.
